key_insight: pymatgen’s 15-year evolution shows that a community-driven, open-source materials science library can scale while continuing to adapt to new computational and informatics needs.
engineering_relevance: For computational materials engineering, pymatgen remains a foundational workflow layer that can accelerate reproducible analysis, model integration, and method adoption across research teams.
method: Retrospective review of pymatgen’s development over 15 years.
Synthesis of community growth, established practices, and new functionality.
Outlook on challenges and solutions for sustaining community-driven evolution.
evidence_signal: The abstract is a narrative retrospective rather than an experimental evaluation, so its evidence is based on long-term community experience and library development history.
watch_item: Because the paper is reflective and community-oriented, specific quantitative performance benchmarks or comparative evaluations may be limited.
paper_title: pymatgen: 15 years of community growth, new functionality, and future prospects
